title: Cockpit-XP import
help: Choose a ZIP backup. It is read only; no Cockpit-XP program or add-on is executed. Only Node is required on every platform.
scope: Recognized data becomes RaceHubOS drivers, cars, tracks, finished sessions, results and laps. Unresolved rows must be corrected or removed. Hardware settings, add-ons, licenses and maintenance information without matching fields are not imported.
reviewHelp: Edit values, check defaults and remove unwanted rows. Results and lap references can be edited. Durations are milliseconds; dates use ISO format.
linksHelp: Create adds a row. Linking an existing object never overwrites it. Previously imported rows are linked automatically without duplicates. A missing brand stays empty and must be filled in.
unresolvedHelp: Some references are missing or ambiguous. Correct their links in the relevant tabs or remove dependent rows before confirming.
confirm: I have reviewed the tabs and confirm the selected rows.
failed: Import failed. Check fields and references, finish active sessions and prepare a fresh preview if necessary. No partial import is kept.
stale: Data changed after the preview. Upload the backup again before confirming.
